model: COMPU25 Chiller Controller - BACnet Web Portal (legacy)
applies_to: Multistack modular water chillers with the COMPU25 master controller and the Multistack BACnet web portal (MS20/30/50 application).
summary: The Multistack web portal is a gateway that talks to a COMPU25 chiller master controller over RS-232 and publishes its data as BACnet IP Analog and Binary Values. The BAS can start and stop the chiller, write the upper/lower chilled water setpoints, VSP and load limit, and read system temperatures, per-compressor status, suction and leaving water temperatures, coded fault values and a 20-entry fault review. This is an older product; the manual dates from 2008.
notes: Legacy product: the manual is dated May 2008. This copy is hosted by a third party (Chipkin), not on a Multistack site.
Points exist for 24 compressors; AV 1 reports how many are actually installed.
Write points (AV 135-143, BV 33) are write-only; read the values back from the matching read points (AV 9-17, BV 1).

The manual's text gives different instance numbers for some points (write setpoints as AV 134-142, flush time/duration as AV 153/154) than its Table 3. Table 3 is self-consistent (AV 134 is FAULT 20 COMP #, AV 153-154 are HRS @ 90-100% and MOST CURRENT FAULT) and the text has other slips, so this list follows Table 3; confirm with a device discovery.
Units are not printed in the table; temperatures follow the manual's degrees F.
Object names are the table's reference names; the short labels (e.g. ENT CHW SYS TEMP) are in the descriptions.

source.title: Multistack BACnet Portal Technical Manual - MS20/30/50 Application, BACnet over TCP/IP

integration.summary: Connect the portal's 10BaseT port to the BACnet IP network and discover device 610001. Start and stop the chiller with BV 33 and check BV 1 for the real state, since the chiller keypad can override it. Write the upper/lower setpoints and load limit to AV 135, 136 and 138, and supervise with the system water temperatures, capacity and fault points.

minimum_points.name: upsetpt_write_1
minimum_points.why: Upper setpoint (entering CHW at full load), 45-80 °F

minimum_points.name: lowsetpt_write_1
minimum_points.why: Lower setpoint (leaving CHW at full load), 35-70 °F

integration.enable: BV 33 ON/OFF CONTROL turns the chiller on (1) or off (0) and should stay on while the BAS wants it running. The hard-wired EX2 input on the COMPU25 must also be closed for the chiller to run; its state shows on BV 3. Multistack also suggests a BAS dry contact on EX2 as an alternative to the network command.
setup: Default device instance 610001; changing it needs Multistack.
Default IP 192.168.1.101, mask 255.255.255.0, gateway 0.0.0.0, UDP port 47808, BACnet network number 6100.
The portal runs BACnet IP only over its 10 Mbps 10BaseT port; the BAS supplies the CAT5 cable.
Portal-to-COMPU25 link is RS-232 at 2400 baud, 8N1, fixed; maximum 50 ft, with the RS232/RS485 jumper set to RS-232.
Addressing DIP switches should be set with 3 and 4 ON, 1, 2 and 5 OFF.
gotchas: BV 33 has the same priority as the chiller's keypad. If someone stops the chiller locally, BV 1 goes off while BV 33 stays on; the BAS must write BV 33 off briefly, then on again to restart.
Write points are write-only; read the current values from the separate read points.
FAULTS C1-C24 and FAULT 1-20 TYPE are coded numbers; decode them with the manual's fault tables (Off mode, Current, Reset, Record).
Fault review entries rotate: MOST CURRENT FAULT (AV 154) says which of the 20 slots is newest.
Most system faults (EX1, EX3, flow, low CHW temperature) need a reset at the COMPU25 before the chiller restarts.

note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source). Point availability varies by firmware and options; verify against the live device.
